title: Dibujo de Crayón de Escena Veraniega Vibrante con Estilo Infantil Juguetón
prompt: A neat, colorful crayon and colored-pencil drawing of a summer scene, featuring iconic seasonal elements and activities like beach, sunshine, ice cream, swimming, and flowers. The style is slightly more polished than a typical child's drawing — clean but still playful lines, uneven perspective, and charming imperfections. The drawing uses bold, vibrant, saturated colors throughout with strong, confident color application. The word 'SUMMER' is written in large, thick multicolored crayon letters at the top of the page. White textured paper background, 1080x1080.
